title: Topological Classification of Univariate Sparse Polynomials via Tropical Geometry
summary: We give the topological classification of some simplest univariate complex fewnomials, and find tropical fans of the fewnomial strata with each topological type. Specifically, for the support $ A=\{d,d+1,d+2,d+3,d+4\},\quad d\geq3, $ we classify the topological equivalence classes of polynomials having two critical values of ramification type $(2,2)$. There is one class for odd $d$ and two classes for even $d$.
